notes: I rewrote the backslash-'t' rule: E11 shows `'\\tt'` → `'d'` and `'t\\t'` → `'d'`, so it's not just a single 't' after a backslash — a whole run of 't's is dropped whenever the run touches a backslash on either side. The new rule handles all E9–E11 cases including the previously-wrong `'\\tt'` and `'t\\t'`.
